implementation_requirements_remaining: The new general-lag analyzer and production-only phase/restart coordinator must be separately implemented, tested, reviewed and source-frozen.
The frozen preparation coordinator predates paired-control outcome gates: a later root admission must explicitly bind the complete control result, actual normal exit and current exclusion.
The offline preparation scalar/RDF definitions require their promised implementation review before long preparation.

Root must separately authorize actual resources and cumulative admission accounting. The32-worker-hour ceiling is a nominal admission budget with committed-boundary drain, not an OS hard-runtime bound.
No new paper-agreement claim follows from these proposals or this review. The future scientific assessment must retain model, finite-cell, thermostat, source-rounding and finite-time limitations.

reviewed_mathematics_and_cohort.chain_uncertainty: The8 whole-chain means are the uncertainty units.20segments,216molecules and overlapping origins do not increase df beyond7. All contrasts are paired within chain; old and new shared-ancestry outcomes cannot be counted as16 independent chains.
reviewed_mathematics_and_cohort.complete_cohort: Every8-chain fixed preparation endpoint and every160 production segment is required; failed seeds/segments and original eligibility failures cannot be dropped. No target-rate or favorable-window stop is introduced.
reviewed_mathematics_and_cohort.finite_origin_counts: 20ps at5fs gives4001 frames. At10ps/index2000, N-k=2001 origins per molecule; retain the lag-specific denominator and no per-record velocity mean subtraction.
reviewed_mathematics_and_cohort.fixed_lag_and_stationarity: All predeclared cutoff/window and early10/late10 contrasts remain visible. Marginal df7 intervals and empirical scalar thresholds do not establish equilibrium, simultaneous coverage or an infinite-time diffusion limit.
reviewed_mathematics_and_cohort.preparation_phase: At absolute step400000, execute exactly the pending normal Maxwell preparation draw with no COM projection. Fixed1.6M added steps contain4000 draws at400-step intervals. Stop at2000000 before the terminal draw.
reviewed_mathematics_and_cohort.production_phase: At2000000, the first NVE COM-projected draw replaces the pending preparation draw; continue the saved RNG for exactly20 draws, one per segment. No thermostat within segments and no final extra draw.20*80000 steps end at3600000.
reviewed_mathematics_and_cohort.structural_measure: Unordered OO pair normalization N(N-1)/2 times shell volume/V is internally consistent. The3.5A coordination uses2*unordered count/N. The final partial radial shell, histogram under/overflow and all fixed blocks remain retained.
reviewed_mathematics_and_cohort.transport_factors: The stored3D VACF dot product requires1/3 on its integral; the3D MSD slope requires1/6. Unwrapped molecular COM displacement must not be minimum-imaged or re-centered.
